UBS Interview Experience  
On-Campus, FTE 
Naveen Nehru  
B.Tech Computer Engineering, VJTI, Batch of 2022 
 
 
UBS visited our campus in August 2021 for recruiting students for the role of IT 
Software Engineer. Students from Computer, IT and EXTC branches with 7 CPI and 
above only were eligible. Total 4 rounds were conducted overall virtually. 
1. Online test 
2. Technical Round 
3. Technical + Managerial Round 
4. HR Round 
 
Round 1 – Online Test 
This round was conducted on HackerRank which consisted of 23 MCQs and one 
Medium level coding question. The duration of the test was 2 hours. The MCQs were 
based on CS fundamentals – Data Structures and Algorithms, OOPs, DBMS, Predicting 
the output of the code (in C++, Java programming languages). The coding question 
was –  
Suppose you have n integers labelled 1 through n. A permutation of those n integers 
perm (1-indexed) is considered a valid arrangement if for every i (1 <= i <= n), either 
of the following is true: 
• perm[i] is divisible by i. 
• i is divisible by perm[i]. 
Given an integer n, return the number of the arrangements that you can construct with 
the given conditions satisfied. 
I solved the question with all the test-cases passed. 
After this round, 18 students were shortlisted for the interviews including myself. 
 
Round 2 – Technical Interview  
The first interview round was scheduled on the next day at 9:00am on Skype Business 
Meetings App. The invite for the interview was sent on mail. My interview was

postponed to 12:30pm as the interviewer could not join at 9:00am due to network 
issues. The duration of the interview was around 45 minutes. 
The interviewer first introduced himself and then asked me to do the same. Next, we 
had a Code Pair link sent on the mail. He asked me to join the link. It had the following 
coding question –  
Complete the function that checks whether a given Linked List contains a loop. If the 
loop is present then it returns pointer to the first node of the loop else it returns NULL. 
I chose C++ for coding. I had to only complete the function, rest of the code i.e. for 
input and output was present already. I solved the question (using hashing) and all of 
the test cases passed. 
Next, the questions asked were – 
1. Explain Encapsulation. 
2. Constructor and its types in C++. (Also asked me to explain with code) 
3. Abstraction and Virtual Functions in C++. (Asked to write code as well) 
4. What is Shallow copy and Deep copy? Difference between them. 
5. What is void pointer and its use? (Asked to write code as well) 
6. Explain the projects mentioned in resume. 
Some more questions were asked, but I don’t remember them. After this, the 
interviewer asked me if I had any questions for him and I asked one. 
I cleared this round and received the link for next round on mail which was scheduled 
at 2:00pm. 
 
Round 3 – Technical + Managerial Interview  
First, the interviewer introduced himself and asked me to do the same. Then the 
questions asked were –  
1. Write a function in Python that returns Factorial of a number and asked to 
explain it. 
2. Two SQL queries based on aggregate functions and operators. 
3. Questions on projects mentioned in resume. 
4. What is cloud computing?  
5. Advantages of cloud computing.  
6. Where is the data stored in cloud? 
7. Do you know anything about DevOps? 
8. Rate your skills in C++, Python and SQL on a scale of 10.

9. Some managerial questions, one of them was - Given a choice to work in a team 
or work individually, what would you choose and why? 
10. Are you comfortable in presenting a topic to a group of people? Do you have 
any past experience in the same? 
11. Your domains of interest?  
Some more questions were asked but I don’t remember them. Finally, the interviewer 
asked if I had any questions for him and I asked about his experience working in UBS. 
This round lasted for around 40 minutes. 
I cleared this round and received the invite for the next round on mail which was 
scheduled at 7:00pm. 
 
Round 4 – HR Interview 
The questions asked were –  
1. Introduce yourself. 
2. What are your hobbies? 
3. What do you know about UBS and why you want to work for us? 
4. Whom do you think are the competitors of UBS? 
5. Do you have any job offer in hand? 
6. Explain your projects. 
7. What are your weaknesses? 
8. Where do you see yourself in 5 years? 
9. Tell me about your family background. 
Finally, the interviewer asked if I had any questions for her and I asked one. This round 
lasted for around 15 minutes.  
The results were announced the next day and I was selected. 
 
 
 
 
 
 
ALL THE BEST
